title: 🔌 External Model Providers
summary: View what's new in Raycast v2.5
body_markdown:
[v2.5](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/2-5) September 24, 2026


Extensions can now provide their own AI models to Raycast. Just install a compatible extension from the Store, complete its setup, and choose its models in AI Chat. It’s an easy way to bring even more models into your everyday workflow.


We updated a few extensions:[Ollama AI](https://www.raycast.com/massimiliano_pasquini/raycast-ollama) ,[AI by Vercel](https://www.raycast.com/ridemountainpig/ai-by-vercel) ,[Cerebras](https://www.raycast.com/EvanZhouDev/cerebras) ,[Groq](https://www.raycast.com/ilian/groq) ,[LM Studio](https://www.raycast.com/vineeth_sai_narajala/lm-studio) , etc.. Developers, check out the[API changelog](https://developers.raycast.com/misc/changelog) for more information.


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI Chat** : Rename a chat by double-clicking its title in the top bar. Press` Enter` to save or` Esc` to cancel, and the window can still be dragged by the title
- **AI Chat** : Dictation with` Ctrl + M` in the AI Chat and Quick AI composers now uses the same processed transcript as the **Dictate** command. The text shows up once you stop recording instead of streaming into the editor while you speak
- **Applications** : Added support for finding apps by alternate names and Spotlight keywords, such as “Codex” for ChatGPT and “Preferences” for System Settings
- **Diagnostics** : Added a warning in Settings → About when another app’s Secure Input may interfere with **Snippet Expansion** or **Hyper Key** , with guidance on resolving it
- **Script Commands** : Added line wrapping to full output so long lines are easier to read


## 🐞 Fixes


- **AI** : Fixed reasoning showing below the answer in chats migrated from Raycast v1
- **AI** : Fixed the tool approval bar not responding in later turns of the same response when using Ollama or OpenAI-compatible custom providers
- **AI** : Fixed failing requests retrying in the background indefinitely during provider outages. Raycast now stops after a few attempts and shows an error with options to change the model, resume, or stop.
- **AI Commands** : Disabled automatic tool discovery and skill loading
- **AI Profile** : Fixed clearing and saving an empty profile
- **Calculator** : Fixed currency conversions using missing or outdated rates during refreshes
- **Clipboard History:** Fixed a hang in Adobe Illustrator caused by image processing when reading the pasteboard
- **Crash:** Improved recovery when the launcher displays a blank window due to a GPU process hang
- **Hotkeys** : Fixed some shortcuts failing to record when key presses arrive after the keys have been released
- **Quick AI** : Fixed` ⌘ + Enter` (Copy Response) and` ⌥ + Enter` (Paste Formatted Response) not working right after a response in some cases
- **Open With…** : Fixed the menu initially selecting an unrelated app before recommended apps finished loading
- **Store** : Fixed **Install Extension Anyway** failing for extensions marked as unsupported on your platform
